counselling_steps: Check the dates: the state authority publishes a schedule for registration, document verification, choice filling and each round.
Register on the official counselling portal with your exam roll number, mobile number and email, and pay the registration fee if asked.
Upload or present documents: mark sheets, entrance score card, domicile, category and income certificates, photo ID and passport photographs.
Fill your college and course choices in order of preference. Add more choices than you think you need; the system allots the first available choice on your list.
Check the provisional allotment result when it is published, then accept it by paying the seat acceptance fee or reporting to the college as instructed.
Choose whether to freeze the seat or float for a better option in the next round, if the state allows it.
Report to the allotted college with original documents, pay the fees and complete admission before the last date, because a missed deadline can cancel your seat.
rural_how: To apply for a state scholarship: confirm eligibility on the portal, keep your income certificate, caste certificate (if applicable), Aadhaar-linked bank account, previous marks and proof of admission ready, register on the scholarship portal, fill the form during the open window and submit it through your college so that it can be verified. Windows usually open after admissions and close within a few weeks, so check the dates early.

gujarat.intro: Admission to engineering, pharmacy and diploma courses in Gujarat is handled by separate state committees. Engineering and pharmacy use GUJCET along with Class 12 marks through ACPC, diploma admission is merit-based through ACPDC, and medical seats follow NEET-UG with state counselling.

exam_details.name: GUJCET
exam_details.eligibility: Class 12 (science stream) from GSEB or an equivalent board, with the subject groups set for the course you want.
exam_details.pattern: A written multiple-choice test in Physics, Chemistry and Mathematics or Biology, conducted by the Gujarat Secondary and Higher Secondary Education Board.
exam_details.selection: ACPC combines your GUJCET score with Class 12 marks in the relevant subjects to prepare the merit list.
exam_details.tip: Prepare the Gujarat Class 11 and 12 syllabus well, because the paper is based on it.

exam_details.name: NEET-UG (for medical)
exam_details.eligibility: Class 12 with Physics, Chemistry and Biology, and the age and attempt rules of the National Medical Commission.
exam_details.pattern: A national multiple-choice exam conducted by the NTA.
exam_details.selection: State quota seats are counselled by the Gujarat medical admission committee in addition to national counselling.
exam_details.tip: Keep domicile and school certificates ready.

exam_details.name: JEE Main (for national institutes)
exam_details.eligibility: Class 12 with Physics, Chemistry and Mathematics.
exam_details.pattern: A national computer-based test.
exam_details.selection: Used for NITs and other national institutes; some Gujarat institutes also accept JEE Main.
exam_details.tip: Prepare for both GUJCET and JEE Main since the syllabi overlap.

gujarat.portal_note: Gujarat counselling for engineering and pharmacy is run on the ACPC portal; diploma counselling is run on the ACPDC portal; medical counselling is run by the Gujarat medical admission committee.
gujarat.polytechnic: Diploma admission in Gujarat is based on Class 10 marks through ACPDC, which runs online registration, document verification and choice filling. After a diploma, students can often take lateral entry into the second year of B.E. or B.Tech. Check the ACPDC brochure for the courses, colleges and seat details.

faqs.q: Is GUJCET compulsory for B.Tech in Gujarat?
faqs.a: For state-quota seats counselled by ACPC, GUJCET is usually part of the process along with Class 12 marks. Check the current ACPC brochure.

faqs.q: Do I need a domicile certificate?
faqs.a: Yes, for most state-quota seats. Keep school-leaving and Class 12 documents ready.

faqs.q: Can I get a diploma seat without an entrance exam?
faqs.a: Yes. Diploma admission through ACPDC is merit-based on Class 10 marks.

maharashtra.intro: Maharashtra runs a large, centralised admission system. MHT-CET is the main entrance test for engineering, pharmacy and agriculture, and admissions run through Centralised Admission Process (CAP) rounds. Seats are split between Home University, Other-than-Home University and State level pools.

exam_details.name: MHT-CET
exam_details.eligibility: Class 12 with Physics, Chemistry and Mathematics for engineering (PCM) or Physics, Chemistry and Biology for pharmacy and agriculture (PCB).
exam_details.pattern: A computer-based test conducted by the State Common Entrance Test Cell, with separate PCM and PCB groups. Scores are reported as percentiles after normalisation across sessions.
exam_details.selection: Merit is based on MHT-CET percentile, and CAP rounds use it for seat allotment.
exam_details.tip: Take sessions seriously because percentiles depend on relative performance.

exam_details.name: NEET-UG (for medical)
exam_details.eligibility: Class 12 with Physics, Chemistry and Biology.
exam_details.pattern: A national multiple-choice exam.
exam_details.selection: The State CET Cell conducts state-quota counselling; many MBBS seats are reserved for Maharashtra candidates.
exam_details.tip: Prepare domicile documents early.

exam_details.name: Other CETs
exam_details.eligibility: Depends on the course.
exam_details.pattern: The CET Cell also conducts tests for law, B.Ed, management, architecture and other courses.
exam_details.selection: Each test has its own merit list and counselling.
exam_details.tip: Check the CET Cell calendar for your course.

reservation_rows.note: Separate shares for each group; read the CET Cell brochure.

maharashtra.portal_note: Engineering and pharmacy counselling are run through CAP rounds on the DTE and State CET Cell portals; medical counselling is run by the State CET Cell.
maharashtra.polytechnic: Maharashtra diploma admission uses Class 10 marks through a CAP process run by the Directorate of Technical Education, and the Maharashtra State Board of Technical Education (MSBTE) sets the syllabus and conducts exams. Diploma holders can often take direct second-year admission to B.Tech. Confirm the details in the current DTE brochure.

faqs.q: What are Home University and Other-than-Home University seats?
faqs.a: Seats are divided by the university region where you studied Class 12. Home University candidates get a larger share in that university's colleges.

faqs.q: What are CAP rounds?
faqs.a: Centralised Admission Process rounds are the state's online rounds of seat allotment based on merit and choices.

faqs.q: Is MHT-CET enough for medical?
faqs.a: No. Medical courses use NEET-UG.

karnataka.intro: Karnataka admissions are run by the Karnataka Examinations Authority (KEA). KCET is the main test for engineering and several other courses, and rank is based on both the entrance score and Class 12 marks. The Kalyana Karnataka region has special reservation under Article 371(J).

exam_details.name: KCET
exam_details.eligibility: Class 12 (PUC II) with the subjects required for the course; Kannada-language and study-in-Karnataka conditions apply to some quotas.
exam_details.pattern: A written test in Physics, Chemistry, Mathematics and Biology, with separate papers for each subject, conducted by KEA.
exam_details.selection: KEA combines KCET marks with Class 12 marks as per its rules to prepare the rank list.
exam_details.tip: Do not neglect Class 12 marks because they affect your rank.

exam_details.name: NEET-UG (for medical)
exam_details.eligibility: Class 12 with Physics, Chemistry and Biology.
exam_details.pattern: A national multiple-choice exam.
exam_details.selection: KEA holds state-quota counselling for MBBS, BDS and AYUSH seats.
exam_details.tip: Keep your study certificates ready.

exam_details.name: COMEDK UGET
exam_details.eligibility: Class 12 with PCM.
exam_details.pattern: A computer-based test for private engineering colleges in the COMEDK consortium.
exam_details.selection: A separate route that is not run by the state.
exam_details.tip: Apply to both KCET and COMEDK for wider options.

reservation_rows.note: The shares were revised by state law; confirm the current figures in the KEA brochure.
Applies to candidates from the region.

karnataka.portal_note: KEA runs registration, document verification, choice entry and seat allotment through its online portal.
karnataka.polytechnic: The Department of Technical Education (DTE), Karnataka runs diploma admission, mainly on Class 10 merit, and lateral entry into the second year of engineering is possible through the diploma entrance (DCET). Check the DTE Karnataka site for courses, colleges and dates.

faqs.q: Does Class 12 matter for KCET rank?
faqs.a: Yes. KEA combines Class 12 marks with the KCET score according to its rules.

faqs.q: What is Article 371(J)?
faqs.a: A constitutional provision that gives special reservation in education and jobs to the Kalyana Karnataka region.

faqs.q: Do private colleges accept KCET?
faqs.a: Many do, through government quota seats. COMEDK covers private colleges in its consortium.

tamil-nadu.intro: Tamil Nadu is unusual because engineering admission through TNEA is based on Class 12 marks rather than a separate entrance test. The state follows its own reservation system, and medical admission uses NEET-UG followed by state counselling.

exam_details.name: TNEA (Tamil Nadu Engineering Admissions)
exam_details.eligibility: Class 12 pass with Mathematics, Physics and Chemistry or the other eligible combinations; Tamil Nadu candidates get priority for state-quota seats.
exam_details.pattern: There is no entrance test; merit is calculated from Class 12 marks. The cut-off uses marks in Mathematics, Physics and Chemistry out of 200.
exam_details.selection: Counselling is run in rounds with choice filling, allotment and confirmation.
exam_details.tip: Focus on your Class 12 marks because they decide your rank.

exam_details.name: NEET-UG (for medical)
exam_details.eligibility: Class 12 with Physics, Chemistry and Biology.
exam_details.pattern: A national multiple-choice exam.
exam_details.selection: State quota seats are counselled by the Tamil Nadu Selection Committee.
exam_details.tip: Check the special reservation for government-school students.

exam_details.name: TNPSC / TRB
exam_details.eligibility: Graduation or higher depending on the post.
exam_details.pattern: Written exams and interviews.
exam_details.selection: For state government jobs, not for admission.
exam_details.tip: Plan this after graduation.

reservation_rows.note: Includes a separate share for Arunthathiyar (3%).

tamil-nadu.portal_note: TNEA counselling is conducted on the official TNEA portal; medical counselling is run by the Tamil Nadu Selection Committee.
tamil-nadu.polytechnic: The Directorate of Technical Education (DOTE) runs diploma admission in Tamil Nadu on Class 10 marks. Many students take diploma first and later join engineering in the second year through lateral entry. Check DOTE for the current notification.

faqs.q: Is there an entrance exam for TNEA?
faqs.a: No. TNEA uses Class 12 marks for ranking.

faqs.q: What is the 69% reservation?
faqs.a: It is the combined reserved share across the categories listed in the table, which is Tamil Nadu's own system.

faqs.q: Is there help for government-school students?
faqs.a: Yes, there are special reservations and schemes, but check the current year's rules.

west-bengal.intro: West Bengal's main state entrance test is WBJEE, conducted by the WBJEE Board, for engineering, pharmacy and architecture. Medical admission uses NEET-UG followed by state counselling, and polytechnic admission uses JEXPO.

exam_details.name: WBJEE
exam_details.eligibility: Class 12 with Physics, Chemistry and Mathematics (and Biology for pharmacy options as per the brochure).
exam_details.pattern: Two papers: Paper 1 is Mathematics and Paper 2 is Physics and Chemistry.
exam_details.selection: Rank is used for state counselling, with domicile and category preferences.
exam_details.tip: Practise with past papers because question styles repeat.

exam_details.name: NEET-UG (for medical)
exam_details.eligibility: Class 12 with Physics, Chemistry and Biology.
exam_details.pattern: A national multiple-choice exam.
exam_details.selection: State quota seats are counselled by the West Bengal medical counselling committee.
exam_details.tip: Keep domicile documents ready.

exam_details.name: JEXPO
exam_details.eligibility: Class 10 pass for polytechnic entry.
exam_details.pattern: An entrance exam for diploma courses.
exam_details.selection: Counselling through the state council for technical education.
exam_details.tip: Check the exam and counselling notifications.

west-bengal.portal_note: WBJEEB runs engineering counselling online; medical counselling is run by the state medical counselling committee.
west-bengal.polytechnic: JEXPO is the entrance exam for polytechnic diplomas in West Bengal, run by the State Council for Technical and Vocational Education and Skill Development. After a diploma, students can take lateral entry into engineering. Check the council's notification for courses and counselling.

faqs.q: What is WBJEE?
faqs.a: The state entrance exam for engineering, pharmacy and architecture in West Bengal.

faqs.q: Do I need a domicile certificate?
faqs.a: Yes, for most state-quota benefits.

faqs.q: What is Kanyashree?
faqs.a: A state scheme that supports girls to continue education; see the scholarships section.

uttar-pradesh.intro: Uttar Pradesh uses JEE Main scores for engineering counselling through UPTAC for colleges affiliated to Dr. A.P.J. Abdul Kalam Technical University (AKTU). JEECUP handles polytechnic entry and medical seats follow NEET-UG with state counselling.

exam_details.name: JEE Main with UPTAC counselling
exam_details.eligibility: Class 12 with Physics, Chemistry and Mathematics; UP domicile gets priority for state-quota seats.
exam_details.pattern: A national computer-based test conducted by the NTA.
exam_details.selection: UPTAC uses JEE Main rank for seat allotment in rounds.
exam_details.tip: Register for UPTAC counselling after JEE Main results.

exam_details.name: JEECUP
exam_details.eligibility: Class 10 or 12 pass depending on the course group.
exam_details.pattern: An entrance exam for diploma and polytechnic courses.
exam_details.selection: Counselling in rounds on the JEECUP portal.
exam_details.tip: Apply on time because seats are limited.

exam_details.name: NEET-UG (for medical)
exam_details.eligibility: Class 12 with Physics, Chemistry and Biology.
exam_details.pattern: A national multiple-choice exam.
exam_details.selection: DGME UP runs counselling for state-quota seats.
exam_details.tip: Keep domicile and category documents ready.

uttar-pradesh.portal_note: UPTAC runs engineering counselling on its portal; JEECUP runs polytechnic counselling; DGME UP runs medical counselling.
uttar-pradesh.polytechnic: In Uttar Pradesh diploma admission is through JEECUP, and the Board of Technical Education sets syllabus and exams. Diploma holders often move into second-year engineering through lateral entry. Check the JEECUP notification for the current process.

faqs.q: Is UPSEE still held?
faqs.a: No. UP engineering counselling now uses JEE Main rank through UPTAC.

faqs.q: What is AKTU?
faqs.a: Dr. A.P.J. Abdul Kalam Technical University, which affiliates many engineering colleges in the state.

faqs.q: Is there help for rural girls?
faqs.a: Yes, schemes such as Kanya Sumangala exist; see the scholarships section.

delhi.intro: Delhi has no separate state engineering entrance test. Engineering seats at DTU, NSUT, IGDTUW and IIIT-Delhi are filled through JAC Delhi using JEE Main rank, and undergraduate arts, science and commerce admissions at Delhi University use CUET-UG scores.

exam_details.name: JEE Main with JAC Delhi counselling
exam_details.eligibility: Class 12 with Physics, Chemistry and Mathematics; Delhi-region candidates get a larger share of seats.
exam_details.pattern: A national computer-based test conducted by the NTA.
exam_details.selection: JAC Delhi allots seats in rounds based on JEE Main rank.
exam_details.tip: Keep Class 12 school details ready to prove Delhi-region status.

exam_details.name: CUET-UG
exam_details.eligibility: Class 12 pass, with subject conditions as set by each programme.
exam_details.pattern: A national computer-based test with domain and language subjects.
exam_details.selection: Used by Delhi University and other central universities.
exam_details.tip: Choose subjects that match your target course.

exam_details.name: NEET-UG (for medical)
exam_details.eligibility: Class 12 with Physics, Chemistry and Biology.
exam_details.pattern: A national multiple-choice exam.
exam_details.selection: Counselling by MCC and the state process.
exam_details.tip: Check which quotas apply.

delhi.portal_note: JAC Delhi runs counselling for its participating engineering institutes; CUET-based admissions run through each university's portal.
delhi.polytechnic: Diploma education in Delhi runs through the Directorate of Training and Technical Education and the Delhi Skill and Entrepreneurship University (DSEU). Admissions are generally based on Class 10 results or the notified process. Check the DTTE and DSEU websites for the current system.

faqs.q: Is there a Delhi CET for engineering?
faqs.a: No. Seats at Delhi's engineering universities are filled using JEE Main through JAC Delhi.

faqs.q: What does Delhi region mean?
faqs.a: A share of seats is for candidates who passed Class 12 in Delhi; confirm the exact rule in the JAC brochure.

faqs.q: Do I need CUET for Delhi University?
faqs.a: Yes, for most undergraduate programmes.

bihar.intro: Bihar's admissions are coordinated by the Bihar Combined Entrance Competitive Examination Board (BCECEB). Engineering counselling generally uses JEE Main rank, polytechnic diplomas use the BCECE (DCECE) exam and medical counselling follows NEET-UG.

exam_details.name: BCECE (DCECE for diploma)
exam_details.eligibility: Class 10 pass for polytechnic entry.
exam_details.pattern: A written entrance exam for diploma courses.
exam_details.selection: BCECEB runs counselling in rounds.
exam_details.tip: Watch for notifications on the board's website.

exam_details.name: JEE Main with UGEAC counselling
exam_details.eligibility: Class 12 with Physics, Chemistry and Mathematics.
exam_details.pattern: A national computer-based test.
exam_details.selection: State engineering counselling is generally run on JEE Main rank; confirm the current process in the notification.
exam_details.tip: Prepare your Bihar-domicile documents.

exam_details.name: NEET-UG (for medical)
exam_details.eligibility: Class 12 with Physics, Chemistry and Biology.
exam_details.pattern: A national multiple-choice exam.
exam_details.selection: BCECEB runs state-quota counselling for medical seats.
exam_details.tip: Check the reservation categories.

reservation_rows.note: The state's reservation limits have been revised and challenged in court, so confirm the current figures in the brochure.

bihar.portal_note: BCECEB runs registration, choice filling and allotment on its portal.
bihar.polytechnic: Bihar polytechnic admission goes through BCECE (DCECE), which has separate groups for different diploma branches. After diploma, students can often move to the second year of engineering through lateral entry. Check the BCECEB website for details.

faqs.q: Is there a Bihar engineering entrance test?
faqs.a: State engineering counselling generally uses JEE Main rank. Confirm the current process on the BCECEB site.

faqs.q: What is the Student Credit Card scheme?
faqs.a: A state scheme that helps eligible students with education loans; see the scholarships section.

faqs.q: Are there schemes for girls?
faqs.a: Yes, schemes such as the Balika Cycle Yojana and Kanya Utthan Yojana support girls' education.
